newsitem.title: USA: Flushing Financial adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Flushing Financial adopts rights plan.

text.p: Flushing Financial Corp said on Wednesday it had adopted a stockholder rights plan, giving shareholders a dividend distribution of one right for each share of common held.
The plan is offered to stockholders of record at the close of business on September 30. The rights expire on September 30, 2006.
Each right allows the holder to purchase 1/100 share of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $64.

Flushing President and Chief Executive James McConnell said in a statement the rights plan is not intended to prevent a takeover of the company. He said it is designed to encourage anyone seeking to acquire the company to negotiate with the baord before attempting a takeover.
